top_news.title: Google's WeatherNext 3 ditches physics simulations and learns weather directly from live satellite data
top_news.dek: Google's WeatherNext 3 replaces traditional physics simulations with direct satellite data processing for faster, higher-resolution weather forecasting.
top_news.brief: WeatherNext 3 eliminates the six-hour delay inherent in numerical weather prediction models by training directly on real-time geostationary satellite data. The model provides hourly forecasts at a 5km resolution, offering significant improvements for regions with limited historical weather data.
top_news.image_alt: Visualization of satellite-based weather forecasting data

top_news.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers
top_news.dek: GPT-6 Astra introduces enhanced attention to detail and advanced 3D modeling capabilities.
top_news.brief: The latest iteration of the Astra model demonstrates improved prompt adherence and sophisticated output generation. Developers can now leverage the model for complex tasks, including the creation of detailed 3D renderings of environments and objects.
top_news.image_alt: GPT-6 Astra generating a 3D model of a pelican

top_news.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
top_news.dek: OpenAI reports that internal coding agents are significantly increasing experiment velocity and research complexity.
top_news.brief: OpenAI is integrating automated coding agents into its research workflows to accelerate deep learning and alignment progress. Early internal data suggests these agents increase the speed of experimentation and allow researchers to tackle more complex tasks under human supervision.
top_news.image_alt: Visualization of AI agent-assisted research workflows

primary.title: Google's WeatherNext 3 ditches physics simulations and learns weather directly from live satellite data
primary.summary: Google Research and DeepMind are releasing WeatherNext 3, a weather model that skips traditional physics simulations and learns directly from real-time satellite data. It produces hourly forecasts at up to five-kilometer resolution, five times more detailed than its predecessor. Google says regions in Africa, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific that have lacked accurate forecasts should see the biggest gains. The article Google's WeatherNext 3 ditches physics simulations and learns weather directly from live satellite data appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: Meta's new real-time audio model is the foundation for AI assistants that never stop listening
primary.summary: Meta's Superintelligence Labs have released Muse Voice Transcribe, a real-time transcription model that processes speech in 80-millisecond chunks, tells speakers apart, and detects sentence boundaries. According to Artificial Analysis, it delivers the most accurate streaming transcription at the lowest price in the market. Meta sees the model as a building block for personal AI agents that listen in on real conversations through devices like its camera glasses. The article Meta's new real-time audio model is the foundation for AI assistants that never stop listening appeared first on The Decod

primary.summary: Researchers at King's College London and other institutions are examining whether "AI-associated psychosis" should become a clinical diagnosis.
